resources.string: Full-screen cluster
Manual test while parked. Closing keeps the profile selected. Restore the factory profile and verify its return before installing an older APK.
1 · Read state and compatibility
2 · Prepare dashboard
3 · Choose application
4 · Open dashboard
Close projection
5 · Confirm observed display
Confirm only if you see the DashCast dashboard, instruments, alerts and application. A command receipt does not prove this display.
Confirm that the vehicle is stationary and the firmware context has been checked. This checkbox is an assertion, not a movement measurement. Validation in the car remains necessary.
One active 1920 × 720 cluster must be detected. Unknown, ambiguous or small geometry refuses this test.
Prepare the DashCast profile first and wait for selection to finish.
○ No dashboard prepared
↩ Restoring
⚠ Uncertain state: use Restore
✓ Opening received; confirm the display
○ Projection closed; factory restore still required
◷ Operation in progress
✓ Profile selected; choose an application and open the dashboard
Application: %1$s
Technical details and previous tests
✓ Display confirmed by the user
Close projection and request the factory profile. A failed close remains unresolved even if the factory profile returns. Then confirm the visible instruments and alerts.
Temporarily activating the original BYD projection…
Waiting for the BYD projection display…
BYD projection display unavailable or incompatible. Check the details.
Initialization started: BYD restoration is required.
Small cluster observed: test refused. BYD restoration remains available.
Close the temporary BYD projection and verify the factory selection. No custom RCC was selected. Then confirm the instruments and alerts have returned.

Preparation may temporarily open the original BYD projection, then check its display before selecting our RCC. No application starts before Open. Confirm parking and firmware; this assertion does not measure movement.
The connected daemon must use protocol %1$d. Reconnect it in DashCast before trying Prepare or Open again. No BYD command was sent.
2b · Full-screen prototype (PC only)
Prototype for PC checks only. Vehicle loading remains unavailable until independent recovery is validated. BYD instruments and alerts are preserved. Restore remains available for the retired profile.
This prototype cannot be loaded in the vehicle. The retired full-screen profile is available for recovery only.
Apply factory selection

The factory profile is already configured but its native application needs verification. Run one BYD projection transition, close it and read the selection again. No custom RCC or repeated factory selection is sent. Confirm parking and firmware.
The retired profile cannot be opened or approved as ready. Use Restore, then separately confirm that the BYD instruments and alerts have returned.
2c · Prepare minimal full screen

Minimal test: in full-screen projection mode the cluster becomes fully transparent and the application fills all 1920 × 720 pixels. BYD instruments, telltales and alerts are hidden during this test. Confirm parking and firmware; this statement does not measure movement.
Confirm only if you see the application across the whole cluster. BYD instruments, telltales and alerts are hidden in this test profile. A command receipt does not prove this display.
